name: io.github.terno-ai/terno
description: Query, explore, and manage your databases through natural conversation.

packageArguments.description: Tool registry to expose. 'query' is read-only; use 'admin' for schema, memory and organisation-prompt writes.

environmentVariables.name: TERNODBI_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the TernoDBI server. Use http://127.0.0.1:8376 for a local 'ternodbi start'.

environmentVariables.name: TERNODBI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Access token minted with 'ternodbi manage issue_token'. Use a query token for the read-only server and an admin token for the admin server.
